newsitem.title: UK: Schroders squeezed higher, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Schroders squeezed higher, trade thin.

text.p: Shares in Schroders Plc were squeezed higher in thin trading on Wednesday as strong markets sparked renewed interest in the recently-underperforming fund management group, dealers said.
"They have underperformed and obviously there is a buyer out there," said one market-maker, noting that shares in rival Mercury Asset Management Plc had also edged higher in recent sessions.
Schroders shares -- often subject to sharp moves because the high proportion of shares owned by the controlling family reduces liquidity in the stock -- were up 52-1/2p at 15.77-1/2 stg by 1219 GMT.
Schroders shares on Tuesday fell as low as 15.10 stg, equalling their lowest level since January 7 and some 15.5 percent below their record 17.88 stg set February 10.
MAM was up 25-1/2p at 12.96-1/2 in volume of 151,314 shares.
Market sources denied talk that BZW had issued a recommendation on Schroders today.
